title: Multi-Task Learning for Metal Alloy Property Prediction: An Empirical Study of Negative Transfer and Mitigation Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2512.22740v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-task learning (MTL) in materials science relies on the assumption that physically related properties share learnable representations. We challenge this assumption using a 54,028-sample metal alloy dataset exhibiting extreme task-level imbalance. Our results reveal a striking dichotomy: MTL significantly degrades regression performance for resistivity and hardness but improves classification recall for amorphous-forming ability. We trace this divergence to mismatched functional forms--such as resistivity's polynomial dependence versus hardness's complex interactions--which cause severe gradient misalignment during optimization. Evaluating Deep Imbalanced Regression techniques, we find that projecting conflicting gradients (PCGrad) recovers single-task performance, while combining label distribution smoothing with gradient normalization achieves the best overall balance. translated_title: 面向金属合金性能预测的多任务学习：负迁移与缓解策略的实证研究
translated_abstract: 材料科学中的多任务学习（MTL）依赖于这样一个假设：物理上相关的属性共享可学习的表示。我们使用一个包含54,028个样本、呈现极端任务级不平衡的金属合金数据集对该假设提出了挑战。我们的结果揭示了一个显著的两极分化现象：MTL显著降低了电阻率和硬度的回归性能，但提升了非晶形成能力的分类召回率。我们将这种差异追溯到函数形式的不匹配——例如电阻率的多项式依赖性与硬度的复杂交互作用——这些不匹配在优化过程中导致了严重的梯度错位。通过评估深度不平衡回归技术，我们发现投影冲突梯度（PCGrad）能够恢复单任务性能，而将标签分布平滑与梯度归一化相结合则实现了最佳的总体平衡。因此，我们提出了一个战略性框架：利用……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究基于5.4万样本的金属合金数据集实证揭示了多任务学习中因任务函数形式不匹配导致的梯度错位负迁移现象——它损害电阻率和硬度的回归性能却提升非晶形成能力的分类召回率，并提出PCGrad以及标签分布平滑结合梯度归一化等有效缓解策略。
en_tdlr: This empirical study on a 54,028-sample metal alloy dataset reveals task-dependent negative transfer in multi-task learning—caused by mismatched functional forms leading to gradient misalignment—which degrades resistivity and hardness regression but improves amorphous-forming classification, and shows that PCGrad and label distribution smoothing combined with gradient normalization can effectively mitigate it.
